correctness.rationale: For every n>=1 and k>=3, induction on the directed suffix gives a true bijection d_i=(x_i+b_{i+1}) mod k and b_i=b_{i+1}+1[d_i=1]. Refractory decay accounts for b=0 separately. Direct exhaustive C++ enumeration verifies full extinction counts for 25 (k,n) pairs and an independently coded Python suffix method verifies burst counts for 35 pairs; both are finite consistency checks, not substitutions for proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete all-size and all-refractory-length dynamical classification on the unique dense acyclic tournament. The constructive triangular permutation makes the nonlinear duration exactly binomial under uniform input, with a rare unique maximum-time initial wave and a normal typical-time limit; this sharply separates typical and worst-case feedforward behavior and supplies a reusable exact benchmark for directed excitable networks. It is not a cosmetic specialization of known undirected or cyclic-contact formulae.
